comment:
Prof. Hudson is great. He's very nice and always happy to help. If you don't understand something, he will try his best to explain it in a way that you can understand. The workload for this class is not bad. He's not the best at grading though.

If this is your first time taking a music class, it may be a little difficult for you.

Dr. Hudson is a legend. So passionate and loves everything he teaches, clearly. Very easy to get extra help outside of class and he's always willing to explain things if they're difficult in a way that is understandable. His material is very topical and relevant and easy to follow! He doesn't rly grade til the end of the semester though but is fair

Dr. Hudson is very knowledgeable and approachable. MUS211 has nightly analysis assignments, 3 projects, no tests, & a short paper. My only critique would be that when he asks you to work in groups to analyze music, he is too quick to jump in and ask how the group is doing, and the students can feel rushed. This is minor, but overall, he's great!

Professor Hudson's class is kind of difficult for a beginner class if you have no musical background, but it is manageable. He is very willing to help out a struggling student with extensions or meetings outside of class. He is a really kind professor and tries his best to get everyone excited and involved. Would 100% take another class with him!

He's ok. He teaches, that's all I have to say about him. Even though the class is targeted to beginners in music, you will struggle if you don't have any experience reading music. Prof. Hudson is reachable outside class and happy to help if you need it. Class is bearable if you are a music geek but there are better and easier electives out there.
